recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片九格拼圖，每格都有大團淡紫至深紫色、雲絮狀、邊緣呈羽毛狀的無細胞沉積物，淋巴球、漿細胞與髓系細胞圍繞或陷於其中；同一種 cloud-like 物質在多個視野重複出現，提示類澱粉（amyloid）浸潤骨髓。
features: Recurrent large extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to deep purple material in all nine fields
Deposits are acellular with granular to faintly fibrillar texture and feathery margins
Small lymphocytes, plasma cells and maturing myeloid cells clustered around or embedded within the deposits
Occasional darker blue cells trapped in the material; background gray-purple red cell masses
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (composite of nine fields) show multiple large, irregular extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to deep purple material with granular to faintly fibrillar texture and feathery margins. Lymphocytes, plasma cells and maturing myeloid cells are clustered around and trapped within the deposits. The consistent appearance across fields favors a true deposit over focal artifact, and is suggestive of amyloid; Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence on particle, clot or trephine sections is required for confirmation. Findings are suggestive of bone marrow involvement by amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: These have a fibrillar meshwork or granular platelet texture, occur in partially clotted samples and are Congo red negative.
Ground substance is pale mucoid background material in a hypocellular smear, Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Precipitate is dark, crystalline or granular, randomly distributed and unrelated to cells.
